ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. The lecture class sessions will be held in Decatur, IL at Tate and Lyle on the following dates and times: 5/19 and 7/1 (1:30 pm to 9:00 pm) and 7/8 (1:30 pm to 4:00 pm). All other classes will be labs and they will be held from 1:30 pm to 9:00 pm on the following dates: 5/26, 5/27, 6/2, 6/3, 6/16, 6/17, 6/23 and 6/24. The labs will be held on the Urbana Campus in room 272 in the Ag Engineering Sciences Building (AESB).
